byteward.sentence: Wayline began charging for robotaxi rides in Port Ellery on Saturday.
The cars have no safety driver behind the wheel.
Its service area covers 31 square miles of the city.
Rides are available from 6 a.m. to midnight.

launch-desk.sentence: Wayline has started paid robotaxi service in Port Ellery.
Fares are $3 to start plus $1.90 per mile.
Wayline plans to grow that to 200 cars by mid-2027.
The company raised $600 million in September.

bench-and-bill.sentence: Wayline started paid robotaxi rides in Port Ellery on Saturday.
Its cars run with no safety driver.
The permit caps Wayline's fleet at 100 cars.
The city will review the permit in May.
Wayline must report any crash to the city within 12 hours.
It also pays the city a fee of 25 cents per ride.

ohm-and-bit.sentence: Wayline's robotaxis began paid rides in Port Ellery on Saturday.
Each car carries five lidar sensors, which map the street around it with laser pulses.
Wayline caps the cars at 45 mph.
Remote operators can suggest a route when a car gets stuck, but they can't steer it.
